The badges and the rotated SUNSET SALE tag are scattered around the can with no grid, and the legal text is unreadable next to a visible missing-asset placeholder. B reads left to right (logo, can, headline/body, CTA) and has clearer hierarchy, but it has fixable flaws: the SUNSET SALE tag is clipped at the right edge, SMALL BATCH is orphaned below the other two badges, the logo sits isolated at the far left, and the legal line is microscopic.
